tasks.subject: Task 1: Exclusion config fields and filter helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Persisted exclusion lists plus a tested, null-safe helper for testing membership.

**Files:**
- Modify: `Emby.Xtream.Plugin/PluginConfiguration.cs`
- Create: `Emby.Xtream.Plugin/Service/ContentExclusionFilter.cs`
- Modify: `Emby.Xtream.Plugin/Emby.Xtream.Plugin.csproj` (InternalsVisibleTo, only if not already present)
- Test: `Emby.Xtream.Plugin.Tests/ContentExclusionFilterTests.cs`

**Verify:** dotnet test --filter ContentExclusionFilterTests

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Emby.Xtream.Plugin/PluginConfiguration.cs", "Emby.Xtream.Plugin/Service/ContentExclusionFilter.cs", "Emby.Xtream.Plugin/Emby.Xtream.Plugin.csproj", "Emby.Xtream.Plugin.Tests/ContentExclusionFilterTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test Emby.Xtream.Plugin.Tests/ --filter ContentExclusionFilterTests -v minimal", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ExcludedVodStreamIds and ExcludedSeriesIds default to empty int[]", "ContentExclusionFilter is internal static with no constructor", "BuildSet(null) returns empty set", "IsExcluded on empty set is always false"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Targeted removal of excluded item folders
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A reusable `RemoveExcludedContent` pass in `StrmSyncService` that deletes the on-disk folder for an excluded item, matching regardless of a `[tmdbid=...]`/`[tvdbid=...]` suffix.

**Files:**
- Modify: `Emby.Xtream.Plugin/Service/StrmSyncService.cs` (before `CleanupOrphans`, line 1682)

**Verify:** dotnet build + full test suite unchanged

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Emby.Xtream.Plugin/Service/StrmSyncService.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet build Emby.Xtream.Plugin/Emby.Xtream.Plugin.csproj -v minimal && dotnet test Emby.Xtream.Plugin.Tests/ -v minimal", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Deletes folder with or without [tmdbid=N]/[tvdbid=N] suffix", "Ignores CleanupOrphans and OrphanSafetyThreshold", "One readdir per subfolder", "Per-item failures logged, pass continues", "Unmapped custom-mode categories skipped"]}
```

**Files:**

- Test: `Emby.Xtream.Plugin.Tests/SyncMoviesIntegrationTests.cs`

**Verify:** dotnet test --filter SyncMoviesIntegrationTests

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Emby.Xtream.Plugin/Service/StrmSyncService.cs", "Emby.Xtream.Plugin.Tests/SyncMoviesIntegrationTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test Emby.Xtream.Plugin.Tests/ --filter SyncMoviesIntegrationTests -v minimal", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Excluded movie writes no STRM", "Existing folder deleted with CleanupOrphans=false", "Folder with [tmdbid=N] suffix deleted", "Non-excluded movies unaffected", "LastMovieSyncTimestamp computed over unfiltered catalogue"]}
```
